Forward Event Added Inf_Lib. Replaced TND with JMP. Initialize on First Scan. ============================================================ Instruction Overview: ----- The event forward instruction is used to prefix and forward an existing event into another event queue. Using the forward instruction provides the ablility to prefix the event message if additional context is required prior to forwarding to the target event queue. All other event data including timestamp remain unchanged.
Instruction Execution: ----- Edge
Supplemental Descriptions: ------ Sts_ERR Enumeration: Value Error Description 1010 New message length including prefix is greater than destination message length 1011 Invalid queue pointer (outside array) 1012 Invalid Prefix Length (Inp_Prefix Length must be greater than or equal zero and less than or equal 82 characters)
Revision Notes: ----- 2.0.00 - Added Inf_Lib. Replaced TND with JMP. Initialize on First Scan. 1.0.00 - Release
